title.zh: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
title.en: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm

current_state.zh: David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying OpenAI's major model releases, has resigned and is publicly warning about AI safety risks in an editorial for The Atlantic.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI一名安全部门员工已辞职并发出警告
updates.title_en: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
updates.what_changed_zh:
曾为OpenAI重大模型发布撰写安全报告的David Robinson本周辞职，并在《大西洋月刊》（The Atlantic）刊发评论文章，公开就AI安全风险发出警告。据有关其离职的报道，他在OpenAI工作约三年半，主导起草了现行的《前沿模型准备框架》（Preparedness Framework），并负责监督12次前沿模型发布的安全报告工作。

Robinson是OpenAI重大模型发布配套安全文件的撰写者，因此他的公开批评会加剧外界对前沿实验室如何开展和披露安全监督的关注。有关其离职的报道称，他希望AI实验室借鉴航空与核能领域的安全实践。

据报道，Robinson负责OpenAI的安全透明度工作，并参与了介绍其模型情况的系统卡（system card）的编写。有报道标题称他将OpenAI的文化形容为“已崩坏”，这一说法来自媒体的引述。
updates.what_changed_en: David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying OpenAI's major model releases, has resigned and is publicly warning about AI safety risks in an editorial for The Atlantic.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying OpenAI's major model releases, has resigned and is publicly warning about AI safety risks in an editorial for The Atlantic.
updates.detailed_summary_en: David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying OpenAI's major model releases, has resigned and is publicly warning about AI safety risks in an editorial for The Atlantic.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI发布《前沿模型准备框架》（Preparedness Framework），并在重大模型发布时配套发布记录风险评估与缓解措施的安全报告和系统卡（system card）。在辞职之前，Robinson的职责正围绕这一信息披露流程展开。
updates.background_en: OpenAI publishes a Preparedness Framework and accompanies major model releases with safety reports and system cards that document evaluated risks and mitigations. Robinson's role centered on that disclosure pipeline before his resignation.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论意见分歧明显：有人质疑Robinson的动机，认为离职时机与股权归属期重合，且他聘请了公关公司；也有人认为业界应更关注当下具体问题，如沙箱隔离和模型有害输出，而非假想的未来风险。部分评论表示，在据称员工承受巨大压力的情况下，很难想象在OpenAI工作会愉快；还有人转而抱怨ChatGPT的界面与会话一致性问题，与本次事件无直接关系。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters were divided: several questioned Robinson's motives, suggesting the timing coincided with vested equity and that he had retained a PR firm, while others argued the field needs more focus on present-day, concrete problems such as sandboxing and harmful model outputs rather than hypothetical future risks. Some said they doubted working at OpenAI is pleasant given the pressure employees are reported to face, and others shifted to unrelated complaints about ChatGPT's UI and conversation consistency.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这是一则人事与治理层面的消息，对加密市场没有直接的托管、流动性或供给传导渠道。若产生影响，也只会通过AI叙事类代币的市场情绪传导，而这类代币对有关前沿实验室如何管理安全监督的消息较为敏感。
updates.market_impact_en: This is a personnel and governance story with no direct custody, liquidity, or supply channel into crypto markets. Any transmission would run only through sentiment around AI-narrative tokens, which can be sensitive to headlines about how frontier labs manage safety oversight.
